==Biography==

===2016 Season===
Ming joined [[Young Miracles]] in January of 2016 and hoped to qualify for the LPL. In the [[LSPL/2016_Season/Spring_Season|2016 LSPL Spring Season]], Young Miracles was one of the more consistent teams and finished 2nd in the regular season. However in the [[LSPL/2016_Season/Spring_Playoffs|2016 LSPL Spring Playoffs]], the team was unable to qualify for the LPL and finished 2nd behind [[EDward Esports]]. After they decided to make a second attempt at qualifying, Young Miracles faced a similar fate and finished 2nd in the regular season of the summer split. Despite having another close 5 game series with [[Newbee Young]], the team failed to qualify, lost 2-3 and finished in 2nd place once again. Ming would then go on to join [[Royal Never Give Up]] as their new support player after [[Mata]]'s departure.

===2017 Season===
[[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]] mentored Ming in the young player's first few splits. The team finished 1st place in Group A of the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]] with a 12-4 regular season record. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Playoffs|playoffs]] although they made it to the finals, they lost 0-3 in dominating fashion to Team WE. The [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]] was very similar as RNG finished again in 1st place with the same 12-4 regular season record, only this time in Group B. The [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Playoffs|playoffs]] went similarly to the spring playoffs for the team. They made it all the way to the finals again but lost 2-3 to EDward Gaming in a reverse sweep this time. 

At the [[2017 Season World Championship]] RNG was placed into Group C along with eventual tournament winners [[Samsung Galaxy]], as well as [[G2 Esports]] and [[1907 Fenerbahçe Esports]]. The team performed incredibly well in their group and went 5-1. They only dropped one game to G2 Esports. In the Quarterfinals their opponent was Fnatic and they defeated them 3-1 in convincing fashion. RNG's Worlds run ended in the Semifinals after a 2-3 loss to SK Telecom T1 in a very close series.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Ming''' is based on his real given name (Sen-Ming).
* Is a fan of ''[[wikipedia:en:Im_Yoon-ah|SNSD Yoona]]''
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on April 23rd, 2020.
** Was the 7th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], and [[COLD]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on June 30, 2021.
** The 3rd player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]] and [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]].
* Reached 5000 assists in the LPL on July 20, 2022.
** The 2nd player to reach 5000 assists in the [[LPL]] after [[meiko]].
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on January 14th, 2022.
** Was the 9th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[meiko]], [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], and [[Flandre]].
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 20, 2022
** The 11th player to reach 500 games in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[meiko]], [[Rookie]], [[xiaohu]], [[Xiye]], [[Flandre]], [[Smlz]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], and [[cold]].
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on March 6, 2023
** The 7th player to reach 600 games in the LPL after [[Rookie]], [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Flandre]], [[Doinb]], and [[Scout]].
* Reached 1000 international assists during [[2022 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2022]] on May 27, 2022 in Semifinals against [[EG.NA|Evil Geniuses]], becoming the 1st player to achieve this milestone.
